name: yukkuri-voice-cross-platform
description: Offline Yukkuri voice workstation for macOS and Linux
author: Akilunafall

scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:assets && node scripts/package.cjs darwin x64 && node scripts/package.cjs darwin arm64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:assets && node scripts/package.cjs linux x64 && node scripts/package.cjs linux arm64
scripts.dist: npm run dist:mac && npm run dist:linux
